run_list_all_products: run the shopping CLI to list all products in the catalog with pagination support
run_add_to_cart: run the shopping CLI to add an item variant to the cart with a specified quantity
run_checkout: run the shopping CLI to checkout the cart and create an order with an optional discount code
run_search_products: run the shopping CLI to search products by name using case-insensitive substring matching
run_cancel_order: run the shopping CLI to cancel an order that is in processed or shipped status
